text: Curaçao is a constituent country in the Kingdom of the Netherlands located north of western Venezuela in the Caribbean Sea. As such, for country streaks purposes, it is counted as the Netherlands.
text_zh: 庫拉索是荷蘭王國的構成國，位於加勒比海委內瑞拉西部以北。因此，在進行連勝挑戰時，它被算作荷蘭。

text: Curaçao uses square licence plates that appear completely white through the blur.
NOTE: While front plates are mandatory, a [minority](https://goo.gl/maps/rXKj6bBALkcMM5Cg9) will still not have front plates.
text_zh: 庫拉索使用方形車牌，經過模糊處理後看起來完全是白色的。
注意：雖然強制規定懸掛前車牌，但仍有[少數](https://goo.gl/maps/rXKj6bBALkcMM5Cg9)車輛沒有前車牌。

text: This **black car** with a **roof rack** is unique to Curaçao.
text_zh: 這輛帶有**車頂架**的**黑色汽車**是古拉索特有的。

text: Due to Curaçao’s semi-arid climate, **cacti** can commonly be seen.
text_zh: 由於古拉索的半乾旱氣候，經常可以看到**仙人掌**。

text: Much of the architecture on Curaçao consists of **simple, one storey bungalows** that are **pastel coloured**. Metal roofs are common on smaller shacks, while tiled roofs can be seen on more expensive houses. Additionally, multi storey villas can sometimes be seen.
text_zh: 古拉索的大部分建築由**簡單的單層平房**組成，且漆成**粉彩色調**。小型木屋常見金屬屋頂，而較貴的房屋則可見瓦片屋頂。此外，有時也能看到多層樓的別墅。

text: The coloured border or road signs can typically be seen continuing onto the back of the signs. These will generally be red or blue.
text_zh: 道路標誌的彩色邊框或標誌本身通常會延續到標誌背面。這些通常是紅色或藍色的。

text: Blue street signs attached to the top of **yellow signposts** are common in Curaçao.
text_zh: 固定在**黃色路標**頂部的藍色路牌在古拉索很常見。

text: **White and black** striped traffic light posts can be seen in urban areas.
text_zh: 在市區可以看到**白黑相間**條紋的紅綠燈柱。

text: Wooden poles with **three horizontal**, **alternating** insulators are common.
NOTE: These poletops can also be found in Brazil, South Africa, and Eswatini.
text_zh: 帶有**三個水平**且**交替**絕緣體的木製電線桿很常見。
注意：這種電桿頂端也可以在巴西、南非和史瓦帝尼找到。

text: The western half of Curaçao is characterised by a semi-arid **rural** **landscape** with green, but dry hills. Houses are spread apart, with the roads in the west quite narrow in width.
text_zh: 古拉索的西半部以半乾旱的**鄉村** **地貌**為特徵，帶有綠色但乾燥的山丘。房屋分佈散落，西部的道路寬度相當窄。

text: A line of **wind turbines** can be seen at this wind farm toward the southeast of Curaçao. The coverage is also notably rainy.
text_zh: 在古拉索東南方的這個風力發電廠，可以看到一排**風力發電機**。這裡的街景覆蓋也以多雨聞名。

text: The **Queen Juliana Bridge** is a wide four lane bridge in Willemstad. It can be recognised by the yellow and blue guardrails, and the view over the city.
text_zh: **朱莉安娜女王橋**是威廉斯達特一座寬敞的四線道橋梁。其特徵是黃藍相間的護欄以及俯瞰城市的景觀。

text: Grote Berg, located in the centre of the island, can be recognised by the **stick** stuck to the front of the camera lens.
text_zh: Grote Berg 位於島嶼中心，可以透過黏在相機鏡頭前方的**棍子**來辨識。
